name: Enchanting Commands
commands_and_keybinds: /ec <enchantment> <level> - enchants the item in your main hand (Tab auto-completes enchantment names); command name configurable via enchantCommandString (default 'ec')
getting_started: Hold an item and run /ec followed by an enchantment and level (requires permission to run commands).
editor_notes: Exact argument syntax is inferred from the description ('add an enchantment to the item in your main hand'); not verified. Server-side only; permission level assumed to be operator. Levels above 10 display as Roman numerals thanks to Enchantment Numbers Fix.
summary: Adds the /ec command for operators to put enchantments on the held item at levels beyond normal limits, including modded enchantments and non-tool items. Intended for admin use rather than normal survival play.
